summary_i18n.en: A yearly scholarship for bright students from low-income families who study in government and aided schools.

source_title: Central Sector Scheme: National Means-Cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (guidelines), Ministry of Education

label_i18n.en: Studying in the class the new scholarship is open to
In a government, government-aided or local body school
Parents' yearly income from all sources is Rs 3.5 lakh or less
Marks in the earlier exam meet the cut-off

note_i18n.en: You must also pass your state's selection test. The 2026-27 application window closed on 15 November 2026, so check the portal for the next one.

research_note: NOT read in full: the guidelines PDF could not be opened (certificate error), so these values come from an excerpt of the official guidelines and PIB notices seen in search results.
